public_rationale: The contemporary forecasts explain the claim: $3.7 billion of revenue plus about $5 billion of losses gives $8.7 billion, which rounds to $9 billion. But those were forecasts published before 2024 ended. Later financial reporting reviewed here does not reconcile completed-year expenses to the same stock-compensation exclusion. The arithmetic is plausible; the historical amount remains unconfirmed on the specified basis.
limitations: The underlying financial statements were not available as a usable primary source.
Treating this solely as a description of contemporary forecasts would produce a different assessment.
